This is a senior-level backend-leaning full-stack engineering role on Factorial's Working Capital team, working remotely on AI-powered financial products and the transactional systems behind them. The work centers on distributed, resilient architecture — robust APIs, relational data modeling, and data consistency at scale — with expectations of autonomy in defining technical scope and trade-offs. The stack spans TypeScript, Node.js, React with Next.js/Vite, and Python in monorepos, backed by PostgreSQL and event sourcing (KurrentDB/EventStore), Apache Pulsar, and Temporal, deployed on GCP and Kubernetes with Dapr, KrakenD, and Istio, plus LiteLLM and OpenAI/Gemini on the AI side.
